comments.story: Something special is happening in Barcelona
comments.why: Cited alongside honeycomb and tiling remark
comments.text: Good idea! Honeycombs are hexagons, and they tile the plane. And they're made of triangles. [VIDEO] We need parks, not car parks! Rather getting zapped on power lines or pooping on cars, the birds can have branches to sit in and flower beds to fertilise.

comments.author: peterburkimsher
comments.story: Show HN: Visualize your day as 144 rectangles
comments.text: "Hexagons are the bestagons" according to CGP Grey. [VIDEO] Personally I prefer fractals. A 6-sided hexagon is just 2* 3-sided triangles. Or 6 of them, depending how you prefer to tile the plane. [LINK] So how about a day schedule organised by Sierpinski triangles? Lots of space in the middle for resting.
